sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

The easiest way to install Product Tabs Manager:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Product Tabs Manager” in the search box
  4. Find our plugin (by PluginEver) and click “Install Now“
  5. After installation, click “Activate“
  6. Navigate to Product Tabs in your admin menu to start creating tabs!

Manual Installation via WordPress Dashboard

If you downloaded the plugin as a ZIP file:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Click “Choose File” and select the plugin ZIP file
  4. Click “Install Now“
  5. After installation completes, click “Activate Plugin“

Manual Installation via FTP

For advanced users who prefer FTP:

  1. Download and unzip the plugin file
  2. Connect to your server using an FTP client (FileZilla, Cyberduck, etc.)
  3. Upload the product-tabs-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  5. Navigate to Plugins → Installed Plugins
  6. Find “Product Tabs Manager” and click “Activate“

After Installation

Once activated, you’ll find a new “Product Tabs” menu item in your WordPress admin sidebar. From there, you can:

  • Create new custom product tabs
  • Manage existing tabs
  • Configure default WooCommerce tabs
  • Adjust plugin settings

Requirements:
* WordPress 5.2 or higher
* WooCommerce 3.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
What is Product Tabs Manager and what does it do?

Product Tabs Manager is a WooCommerce plugin that allows you to create, customize, and manage product tabs on your WooCommerce store. You can add unlimited custom tabs, rename or hide WooCommerce’s default tabs, and organize product information in a user-friendly tabbed format. It’s perfect for adding specifications, FAQs, size guides, shipping information, videos, and any other content to your product pages.

Can I create tabs for specific categories or products?

Yes! Product Tabs Manager offers flexible targeting options. You can create:
– Global tabs that appear on all products
– Category-specific tabs that only show on certain product categories
– Product-specific tabs (Pro feature) that appear on individual products only
You can also exclude specific products or categories from showing certain tabs with the Pro version.

Is Product Tabs Manager compatible with my WordPress theme?

Product Tabs Manager is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. It integrates with WooCommerce’s standard tab system, so if your theme supports WooCommerce product tabs, it will work with our plugin. Popular themes like Storefront, Flatsome, Astra, OceanWP, Divi, and hundreds of others work perfectly.

Can I rename WooCommerce’s default tabs like Description and Reviews?

Absolutely! You have full control over WooCommerce’s default tabs. You can rename them (e.g., change “Description” to “Product Details”), reorder them to match your priorities, or completely hide tabs you don’t need.

How do I add icons to my product tabs?

Tab icons are a Pro feature. With Product Tabs Manager Pro, you can choose from a library of FontAwesome icons to add visual appeal to your tabs. Icons help customers quickly identify tab content and improve the overall user experience.

Can I embed videos in product tabs?

Yes! You can easily embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos directly into your tabs. Simply paste the video URL or embed code into the tab content editor, and the video will display on your product page.

Does the plugin support shortcodes?

Yes, full shortcode support is included in the free version. You can embed content from other plugins like contact forms, image galleries, accordions, tables, and any other shortcode-powered content directly into your tabs.

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Product Tabs Manager is built with performance as a priority. We’ve optimized all database queries and code to ensure minimal impact on your store’s loading speed. The plugin also works seamlessly with popular caching plugins like WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, and WP Rocket.

Is Product Tabs Manager compatible with WPML and Polylang?

Yes! The plugin is fully translation-ready and works perfectly with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, and other multilingual plugins. You can create different tab content for each language on your international store.

How does the drag-and-drop sorting feature work?

With the Pro version, you can rearrange your tabs simply by dragging and dropping them into your preferred order. This intuitive interface makes it easy to prioritize important information without dealing with complicated settings.

Can I add FAQ-style content with expandable questions?

Yes! The Pro version includes a dedicated FAQ/Q&A tab type that displays questions and answers in an organized, expandable accordion format. This is perfect for product FAQs and helps customers find answers quickly.

Does the plugin work with page builders like Elementor?

Product Tabs Manager works alongside popular page builders. While tabs are managed through our dedicated interface, you can use shortcodes from page builders within your tab content. Full native page builder integration is planned for future releases.

Is there a limit to how many tabs I can create?

No! Both the free and Pro versions support unlimited custom tabs. Create as many tabs as your products need without any artificial restrictions.

Can I preview tabs before publishing?

Yes, you can preview how your tabs will look directly from the WordPress admin area. Make adjustments and see changes before making them live on your store.

What happens to my tabs if I deactivate the plugin?

Your tab data is safely stored in the WordPress database. If you deactivate and later reactivate the plugin, all your tabs and settings will still be there. If you permanently delete the plugin, the tab data will also be removed.

Is Product Tabs Manager GDPR compliant?

Yes. Product Tabs Manager doesn’t collect any personal data from your customers. The plugin only manages content display on your product pages, so your store remains fully GDPR compliant.

Do you offer support if I have issues?

Yes! Free users can access support through the WordPress.org support forums. Pro users receive priority support with faster response times through our dedicated support system at pluginever.com.

Can I use Product Tabs Manager on multiple websites?

The free version can be used on unlimited websites. Pro license terms vary by package—please check our website for current licensing options.

sections.description:
Create unlimited custom WooCommerce product tabs, manage default tabs, add extra product information tabs, specifications, FAQs & more.

📖 Description

Product Tabs Manager for WooCommerce is the most powerful and user-friendly plugin for creating, customizing, and managing product tabs on your WooCommerce store. Whether you’re running a small online shop or a large eCommerce business, this plugin gives you complete control over how product information is displayed to your customers.

Are you tired of the limited default WooCommerce product tabs? Do you want to add custom tabs for specifications, FAQs, size guides, shipping information, or video tutorials? Product Tabs Manager makes it incredibly easy to enhance your product pages without writing a single line of code.

🛒 The Ultimate WooCommerce Product Tabs Solution

Every successful online store knows that well-organized product information leads to better customer experience and higher conversion rates. When shoppers can easily find the information they need—whether it’s product specifications, care instructions, warranty details, or frequently asked questions—they’re more likely to make a purchase.

Product Tabs Manager transforms your WooCommerce product pages by allowing you to:

  • Create unlimited custom product tabs with rich content
  • Rename, reorder, or hide WooCommerce’s default tabs (Description, Additional Information, Reviews)
  • Add tabs globally across all products or target specific categories
  • Insert videos, images, shortcodes, and HTML directly into tabs
  • Display product FAQs in an organized question-and-answer format
  • Show related products, upsells, or cross-sells in dedicated tabs

🎯 Why Product Tabs Are Essential for Your WooCommerce Store

Product tabs serve as the backbone of product page organization. Here’s why investing in a quality tab management solution matters:

1. Improved User Experience
Customers don’t want to scroll through endless paragraphs of text. Tabs let them quickly navigate to the information they care about most. A customer looking for size information can click directly on a “Size Guide” tab instead of hunting through a wall of text.

2. Increased Time on Page
When product information is well-organized into logical tabs, customers spend more time exploring. This increased engagement signals to search engines that your content is valuable, potentially boosting your SEO rankings.

3. Higher Conversion Rates
Studies show that customers who can easily find product information are more likely to complete their purchase. Clear, organized tabs reduce confusion and build trust with potential buyers.

4. Better Mobile Experience
On mobile devices, tabs are even more crucial. They help condense information into manageable sections, making it easier for mobile shoppers to find what they need without excessive scrolling.

5. SEO Benefits
Structured content in tabs helps search engines understand your product pages better. Each tab can target different long-tail keywords, improving your chances of ranking for various search queries.

💻 Live Demo | 🚀 Get PRO Version | 🛠 Support | 📄 Documentation

💡 Why Store Owners Choose Product Tabs Manager

✅ No Coding Required
You don’t need to be a developer to create beautiful, functional product tabs. Our intuitive interface makes tab management accessible to everyone. Simply fill in the fields, choose your settings, and publish—it’s that simple.

✅ Works With Any Theme
Product Tabs Manager is built to integrate seamlessly with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. Whether you’re using Storefront, Flatsome, Astra, OceanWP, or any other popular theme, your tabs will look great and function perfectly.

✅ Lightning Fast Performance
We’ve optimized every line of code to ensure the plugin doesn’t slow down your store. Fast-loading product pages mean happier customers and better search engine rankings.

✅ Regular Updates & Support
Our dedicated team continuously improves the plugin with new features, security updates, and compatibility fixes. Plus, our support team is always ready to help if you run into any issues.

✅ Translation Ready
Selling internationally? Product Tabs Manager is fully translation-ready and compatible with popular multilingual plugins like WPML and Polylang.

🌟 Perfect For These Use Cases

📦 Product Specifications
Create detailed specification tabs for electronics, appliances, or any products with technical details. List dimensions, materials, features, and more in an organized format.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Answer common customer questions directly on your product pages. FAQ tabs reduce support inquiries and help customers make informed decisions.

📏 Size Guides & Fitting Information
Essential for clothing, shoes, and accessories stores. Help customers choose the right size with dedicated size guide tabs.

🚚 Shipping & Delivery Information
Display product-specific shipping details, estimated delivery times, and shipping restrictions in a dedicated tab.

📋 Care Instructions & Maintenance
Share washing instructions, maintenance tips, and care guidelines to help customers get the most out of their purchases.

🎬 Video Tutorials & Demonstrations
Embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted videos to showcase your products in action. Video content can significantly boost conversion rates.

📜 Warranty & Return Policy
Display product-specific warranty information and return policies to build customer confidence.

🔗 Related Products & Accessories
Show complementary products, accessories, or spare parts in dedicated tabs to increase average order value.

💪 What Makes Product Tabs Manager Different?

Unlike basic tab plugins that offer limited functionality, Product Tabs Manager provides enterprise-level features while remaining incredibly easy to use:

🎨 Complete Customization Control
Every aspect of your tabs can be customized to match your brand. From tab titles to content formatting, you have full creative control.

📊 Smart Tab Targeting
Apply tabs globally, to specific categories, or to individual products. This flexibility ensures customers only see relevant information.

🔄 Dynamic Content Support
Use shortcodes to display dynamic content from other plugins. Integrate forms, galleries, accordions, and more directly into your tabs.

📱 Mobile-Responsive Design
Your tabs automatically adapt to different screen sizes, ensuring a great experience on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.

⚡ Lightweight & Optimized
We’ve engineered the plugin to have minimal impact on your site’s performance. No bloated code, no unnecessary database queries.

🌟 Free Features – Everything You Need to Get Started

Our free version includes all the essential features to transform your WooCommerce product pages:

✅ Unlimited Custom Product Tabs
Create as many tabs as your products need. There are no artificial limits holding you back. Add tabs for specifications, materials, care instructions, FAQs, videos, and anything else your customers need to know.

✅ Global Tabs for All Products
Set up tabs once and apply them across your entire product catalog. Perfect for store-wide information like shipping policies, warranty details, or brand stories that apply to all products.

✅ Category-Specific Tabs
Different product categories often need different information. Create tabs that only appear for specific categories—show size guides only for clothing, technical specs only for electronics, or care instructions only for furniture.

✅ Full WooCommerce Default Tab Control
Take complete control over WooCommerce’s built-in tabs:
* Rename tabs to match your brand voice (change “Description” to “Product Details”)
* Reorder tabs to prioritize the most important information
* Hide tabs you don’t need (remove “Additional Information” if it’s not relevant)

✅ Shortcode Support for Dynamic Content
Embed content from other plugins using shortcodes. Display contact forms, image galleries, accordions, tables, or any other shortcode-powered content directly in your tabs.

✅ Rich Text Editor
Use the familiar WordPress editor to create tab content. Add formatted text, headings, lists, images, and media just like you would in a regular post or page.

✅ Tab Visibility Controls
Show or hide tabs based on various conditions. Keep draft tabs hidden while you perfect the content, then publish when ready.

✅ Admin Preview Interface
Preview how your tabs will look before publishing. Make adjustments and see changes in real-time from the WordPress admin area.

✅ Active/Inactive Toggle
Quickly enable or disable tabs without deleting them. Perfect for seasonal content or temporary promotions.

🚀 Pro Features – Take Your Store to the Next Level

Upgrade to Product Tabs Manager Pro for advanced features that give you even more control:

🔸 Exclude Tabs for Specific Products
Hide certain tabs from individual products. If a product doesn’t need a size guide or warranty tab, simply exclude it.

🔸 Exclude Tabs for Specific Categories
Prevent tabs from appearing on entire categories. Perfect for managing different product types with unique information needs.

🔸 Disable Default Tabs Globally
Completely remove WooCommerce’s default tabs across your entire store with a single click. Start fresh with only your custom tabs.

🔸 Drag-and-Drop Tab Sorting
Intuitively rearrange your tabs by simply dragging and dropping them into your preferred order. No complicated settings—just drag to reorder.

🔸 Product-Level Tab Management
Edit, disable, or customize tabs directly from the individual product edit screen. Override global settings on a per-product basis.

🔸 Beautiful Tab Icons
Add FontAwesome icons to your tabs for enhanced visual appeal. Icons help customers quickly identify tab content and improve the overall user experience.

🔸 Custom CSS Support
Apply custom CSS to style your tabs exactly how you want. Match your brand colors, fonts, and design aesthetic.

🔸 FAQ/Q&A Style Tabs
Create interactive question-and-answer tabs perfect for product FAQs. The expandable accordion format keeps content organized and easy to navigate.

🔸 Product List Tabs
Display related products, upsells, cross-sells, or custom product collections in dedicated tabs. Increase average order value by showcasing complementary items.

🔸 Product-Specific Tabs
Create tabs that appear only on specific products. Ideal for unique product features, special instructions, or exclusive information.

🔸 Priority Support
Get fast, dedicated support from our expert team. Pro users receive priority responses to ensure your store runs smoothly.

🔮 Upcoming Features – What’s Next

We’re constantly improving Product Tabs Manager based on user feedback. Here’s what’s coming soon:

🌟 Dynamic Attribute-Based Tabs: Automatically generate tabs based on product attributes like size, color, material, or custom attributes.

🌟 Advanced Review Tab System: Create a dedicated review tab with filtering, sorting, and enhanced display options.

🌟 Page Builder Integration: Seamless compatibility with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and other popular page builders.

🌟 Pre-Designed Tab Templates: Quick-start templates for common use cases including FAQs, specifications, warranty info, and more.

🌟 Import/Export Configuration: Save your tab configurations and reuse them across multiple products or websites.

🌟 Tab Analytics Dashboard: Track which tabs customers view most to optimize your content strategy.

🌟 Conditional Tab Logic: Show or hide tabs based on inventory status, price ranges, product type, or custom conditions.

🌟 Product Comparison Tabs: Enable customers to compare product specifications side by side.

🌟 WooCommerce Blocks Integration: Manage tabs visually using the Gutenberg block editor.

🌟 REST API Support: Developer-friendly API for custom integrations and headless commerce setups.

🏪 Industry-Specific Applications

Product Tabs Manager adapts to any industry or product type:

👗 Fashion & Apparel Stores
Create size guide tabs, fabric information, care instructions, and styling suggestions. Help customers find their perfect fit and reduce return rates.

💻 Electronics & Technology
Display detailed specifications, compatibility information, user manuals, and video tutorials. Technical products need comprehensive information tabs.

🏠 Home & Furniture
Show assembly instructions, dimension details, material specifications, and room styling ideas. Help customers visualize products in their space.

💄 Beauty & Cosmetics
List ingredients, usage instructions, skin type recommendations, and application tutorials. Transparency builds trust in beauty products.

🍽️ Food & Grocery
Display nutritional information, allergen warnings, storage instructions, and recipe ideas. Essential for food safety and customer convenience.

🔧 Tools & Hardware
Show technical specifications, safety guidelines, warranty information, and instructional videos. Professional users need detailed product data.

📚 Books & Media
Display excerpts, author information, reviews, and related recommendations. Engage readers with rich product content.

🎮 Gaming & Entertainment
Show system requirements, gameplay videos, DLC information, and community reviews. Gamers want detailed product information before purchasing.

📊 How Product Tabs Improve Your Store’s SEO

Well-structured product tabs contribute significantly to your store’s search engine optimization:

Content Organization
Search engines favor well-organized content. Tabs create a logical structure that helps search crawlers understand your product pages better.

Keyword Targeting
Each tab can target specific long-tail keywords. A “Size Guide” tab can rank for “product name size guide,” while a “Care Instructions” tab can rank for “how to care for product name.”

Reduced Bounce Rate
When customers find information easily, they stay longer on your pages. Lower bounce rates signal to search engines that your content is valuable.

Rich Content Opportunities
Tabs encourage you to add more valuable content—specifications, FAQs, videos, and guides—that search engines love to index.

Mobile User Experience
Google prioritizes mobile-friendly websites. Tabs improve mobile navigation, which positively impacts your mobile search rankings.

Internal Linking
Product list tabs create natural internal linking opportunities, helping search engines discover more of your content.

🔒 Security & Performance You Can Trust

Secure Code Practices
Product Tabs Manager follows WordPress coding standards and security best practices. We regularly audit our code and release security updates promptly.

Optimized Database Queries
We’ve minimized database calls to ensure your store remains fast, even with hundreds of custom tabs across thousands of products.

Caching Compatible
The plugin works seamlessly with popular caching plugins like WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, and WP Rocket.

CDN Friendly
All assets are optimized for Content Delivery Networks, ensuring fast loading times for customers worldwide.

GDPR Compliant
Product Tabs Manager doesn’t collect any personal data from your customers. Your store remains fully GDPR compliant.

🌍 Built for Global Stores

Translation Ready
Every string in the plugin can be translated. Create tabs in any language to serve your international customers.

RTL Support
Full right-to-left language support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and other RTL languages.

WPML & Polylang Compatible
Works seamlessly with popular multilingual plugins, allowing you to create different tab content for each language.

Multi-Currency Store Support
Product Tabs Manager works perfectly with multi-currency plugins for international WooCommerce stores.

🛠️ Easy Integration With Your Favorite Tools

Product Tabs Manager integrates smoothly with popular WordPress and WooCommerce plugins:

Page Builders
* Elementor
* Divi Builder
* WPBakery Page Builder
* Beaver Builder
* Gutenberg Block Editor

SEO Plugins

📊 How Product Tabs Improve Your Store’s SEO

Well-structured product tabs contribute significantly to your store’s search engine optimization:

Content Organization
Search engines favor well-organized content. Tabs create a logical structure that helps search crawlers understand your product pages better.

Keyword Targeting
Each tab can target specific long-tail keywords. A “Size Guide” tab can rank for “product name size guide,” while a “Care Instructions” tab can rank for “how to care for product name.”

Reduced Bounce Rate
When customers find information easily, they stay longer on your pages. Lower bounce rates signal to search engines that your content is valuable.

Rich Content Opportunities
Tabs encourage you to add more valuable content—specifications, FAQs, videos, and guides—that search engines love to index.

Mobile User Experience
Google prioritizes mobile-friendly websites. Tabs improve mobile navigation, which positively impacts your mobile search rankings.

Internal Linking
Product list tabs create natural internal linking opportunities, helping search engines discover more of your content.
